verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a REST API and a Connect API reference with SDKs, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples. A static code snippet and the workflow 'Send Test Event' button are different features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
